title: kbroot.fetch_env keeps GIT_ASKPASS and SSH_ASKPASS, so a fetch can show a credential prompt
goal: kbroot.fetch_env drops GIT_ASKPASS and SSH_ASKPASS and git runs with core.askPass empty and the GCM non-interactive value the kb's fact names, so a fetch never prompts for a credential, and kb/_self/tools.md's kbroot row says only what the code does (SP-s2svf5a6 review gaps 5 and 13)

run:
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
os.environ["GIT_ASKPASS"] = "/x/askpass"; os.environ["SSH_ASKPASS"] = "/x/askpass"
import kbroot
e = kbroot.fetch_env()
left = [k for k in ("GIT_ASKPASS", "SSH_ASKPASS") if e.get(k)]
print("askpass left in fetch_env:", left)
sys.exit(1 if left else 0)

import os, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); cfg = os.path.join(d, "gitconfig")
open(cfg, "w").write("[core]\n\taskPass = /x/askpass\n")
os.environ.update(GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=cfg, GIT_ASKPASS="/x/askpass", SSH_ASKPASS="/x/askpass")
import kbroot
e = kbroot.fetch_env()
left = [k for k in ("GIT_ASKPASS", "SSH_ASKPASS") if e.get(k)]
class P: url = "https://git.corp.example.com/team-a/kb.git"
ok, out = kbroot.git_out(["config", "--get", "core.askPass"], P(), d)
print("askpass left in fetch_env:", left, "| core.askPass seen by a fetch's git:", repr(out))
sys.exit(1 if left or out == "/x/askpass" else 0)

row = [l for l in open("kb/_self/tools.md").read().splitlines() if l.startswith("| `python3 _tools/kbroot.py list`")][0]

miss = [w for w in ("GIT_ASKPASS", "SSH_ASKPASS", "GCM_INTERACTIVE") if w not in row]
print("the kbroot row of tools.md does not name:", miss)
raise SystemExit(1 if miss else 0)

options: git -c core.askPass= on each call, GCM_INTERACTIVE=0
